replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Whenever I see complex formulas or equations, I feel that familiar knot of tension in my stomach. My low openness score probably plays a role, as I prefer concrete things over abstract concepts. Math anxiety is real for me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I did try using some AI tools recently, and honestly it felt like trying to learn French while speaking Spanish. It helped explain things, but I never felt comfortable enough to trust it completely. The results were okay, but I still preferred textbooks.
